about: Shared, community-curated registry of tools the operator can suggest or call. kind: builtin = included in a ChatGPT plan (free to the user); openai-api = OpenAI platform tools; mcp = MCP server; gpt = GPT Store; api = plain API. callable = mcp_url + auth none/optional → usable via plugin_call. Propose additions with plugins op:propose or a PR. Every deployment reads the latest copy from main.

plugins.name: ChatGPT Web Search
plugins.description: Live web results with citations, inside ChatGPT. Covered by the user's plan.

plugins.name: ChatGPT Deep Research
plugins.description: Multi-step, multi-source research report with citations (minutes, not seconds).

plugins.name: ChatGPT Python / Code Interpreter

plugins.name: ChatGPT Canvas

plugins.name: ChatGPT Agent

plugins.name: ChatGPT Projects + Memory
